weakness: Standing privilege and weak change approval
impact: Stolen admin session plus standing privilege changes cross-cloud trust; broad data access. A4, TB1/3.

controls.prevent: Phishing-resistant MFA; time-bound admin; dual approval for trust edits
controls.detect: Alert on privilege activation and trust change followed by unusual reads
controls.respond: Disable identity; apply resource deny; remove trust; assess issued sessions

validation: Unapproved trust edit rejected; exercise session containment

weakness: Server trusts caller document IDs or ACL labels
impact: API trusts document IDs or caller ACL labels; employee retrieves another group's confidential chunks. A1-3, F3/5.

controls.prevent: Server-side document authorization before retrieval, source fetch and citations; isolate caches
controls.detect: Alert on successful unauthorized canary retrieval and repeated denials
controls.respond: Disable affected retrieval route; invalidate caches
controls.recover: Repair ACL propagation and rebuild affected index

validation: Two-user cross-group tests return zero unauthorized chunks, citations or cached answers

weakness: Wildcard subjects/audiences and excess resource permission
impact: Federation accepts broad subject/audience; compromised workload acquires unintended AWS/GCP permissions. A1/2/4, TB3/4.

controls.prevent: Exact issuer subject audience and environment bindings; separate query/ingestion identities
controls.detect: Unexpected role exchange or resource access
controls.respond: Remove trust and deny principal at resources
controls.recover: Rebuild scoped trust using reviewed IaC

validation: Wrong issuer subject audience and environment all fail; valid identity has only required permissions

weakness: Untrusted text treated as instructions or excessive context sent
impact: Malicious retrieved text influences model; excessive context or unsafe rendering leaks data or misleads users. A2/3, TB2.

controls.prevent: Separate instructions from content; minimize context; no model-controlled authorization; escape output
controls.detect: Track injection evaluation failures and anomalous citations
controls.recover: Restore approved prompt and trusted index

validation: Adversarial documents cannot expand access or trigger actions; evaluate answer reliability separately

weakness: Same principal can delete production and every backup
impact: Attacker deletes source/index and backups using same authority; recovery fails. A1/2/6, TB6.

controls.prevent: Separate backup authority; retained versions; reviewed deletion policy
controls.detect: Backup retention changes and mass deletion
controls.respond: Freeze destructive identities; preserve surviving copies
controls.recover: Restore trusted source and ACLs into clean environment and reindex

validation: Restore drill measures RTO 4h and RPO 24h targets; compromised production identity cannot delete all copies

weakness: Runner or dependency can publish unapproved privileged image
impact: Compromised dependency or runner publishes privileged image; runtime steals tokens and reads documents. A4/5, TB5.

controls.prevent: Isolated builds; dependency checks; provenance/digest verification; independent release approval
controls.detect: Artifact drift and unusual runtime processes
controls.respond: Freeze releases; isolate workloads; deny identity
controls.recover: Rebuild clean artifact and redeploy reviewed version

validation: Unapproved digest and unreviewed release rejected; record approval and provenance

weakness: SSRF or runtime compromise plus excessive workload privilege
impact: SSRF or runtime compromise reaches credentials; overbroad workload role enables secret/data reads. A1/4, TB2/3.

controls.prevent: SSRF input/egress checks; minimal identity grants; non-root workload; no unnecessary secrets
controls.respond: Isolate runtime; deny identity; rotate exposed secrets

validation: Bounded SSRF tests and permission checks prove non-required stores/secrets inaccessible

weakness: Public access permissive key grants or verbose prompt logs
impact: Public store, permissive key policy or verbose prompt logs expose confidential data. A1-4, TB3/6.

controls.prevent: Block public access; scope decrypt grants; encrypt; redact logs
controls.detect: Exposure drift and unusual object/decrypt reads
controls.respond: Restrict resource; rotate exposed secrets; assess disclosure

validation: Verify anonymous access denied and test sensitive markers absent from logs

weakness: No user quotas concurrency limits or timeouts
impact: User floods costly requests or dependency fails; no quotas/fallback produces outage and cost spike. A3, F2/5/6.

controls.prevent: Per-user quotas; request/token limits; circuit breakers
controls.detect: Volume/spend twice baseline for 10 minutes; error/latency alert
controls.respond: Throttle requests; disable generation with safe unavailable response
controls.recover: Restore capacity and verify dependency health

validation: Bounded load and dependency-failure test verifies caps and safe failures

weakness: Unreviewed source writes or ACL metadata tampering
impact: Curator/connector can overwrite approved source and ACL metadata; poisoned knowledge corrupts answers. A1-3, F4.

controls.prevent: Read-only ingestion; approved source versions; provenance checks
controls.detect: Unexpected source version/hash or ACL drift

validation: Tampered source and ACL metadata quarantined; trusted reindex passes authorization tests

impact: Privileged actor disables audit or erases records; misuse cannot be attributed. A6, TB6.

controls.prevent: Independent restricted log destination and retention protections
controls.detect: Required log stream absent for 10 minutes or unapproved retention change
controls.respond: Preserve independent evidence; restrict destructive access
controls.recover: Restore collector and approved logging configuration

validation: Safe log-disable event reaches SOC within target and production admin cannot erase archive
